companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Tickers ("AAPL", "BRK.B"), SEC CIK numbers ("320193") or company names as filed with the SEC ("Microsoft"). One company per entry, up to 500. A name that matches several filers returns a free ambiguous row listing candidate tickers.

period.title: Period
period.description: annual = one row per fiscal year (10-K, 20-F, 40-F). quarterly = one row per fiscal quarter (10-Q, plus Q4 derived from the 10-K). both = annual and quarterly rows.

years.title: Years of history
years.description: How many of the most recent fiscal years to return per company (quarterly returns 4 quarters per year). Default 5. Ignored when fiscalYearFrom or fiscalYearTo is set.

fiscalYearFrom.title: From fiscal year
fiscalYearFrom.description: Optional. Only periods in this fiscal year or later, e.g. 2018. Fiscal years follow the company's own label (Apple's FY2026 ends Sep 2026).

fiscalYearTo.title: To fiscal year
fiscalYearTo.description: Optional. Only periods in this fiscal year or earlier, e.g. 2024.

includeSources.title: Include XBRL concept names
includeSources.description: Adds a sources object mapping each metric to the XBRL concept it came from (e.g. revenue: RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax). Useful for audits. Default off.

includeStatusRows.title: Include free status rows
includeStatusRows.description: Return a free row for each company that could not be answered (not_found, ambiguous, no_xbrl_data, no_periods, duplicate, service_unavailable, skipped_charge_limit) with the reason. Default on.
